|game_text=When drawn for destiny, if three Ewoks and/or Wookiees on table, destiny +2. Deploy a bowcaster or Ewok weapon from Lost Pile. OR Take an Ewok or Wookiee of power < 6 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During battle at same site as Part Of The Tribe, add one battle destiny.
|errata_history={{Card errata/Life Day}}
This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Life Day]] (version 2 of 3). The current text is [[Life Day (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version is the Players Committee's own card image, quoted in full with its upload date; the image on each page is that version's image as published (unchanged). The PC card data (swccg-card-json) is cited as dating evidence only.
* '''Original''' ([[Life Day]]): the card image at official release (20 July 2024)<ref name="ht-335d47f">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/lifeday.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Light/large/lifeday.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36 335d47f] “Set 23 new images”, 20 July 2024.</ref> prints: “When drawn for destiny, if three Wookiees and/or Ewoks on table, destiny +2. Deploy a bowcaster or Ewok weapon from Lost Pile. OR Take an Ewok or Wookiee of power < 6 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During battle at same site as Part Of The Tribe, add one battle destiny.”<ref name="cj-753083f">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/753083f swccg-card-json commit 753083f] “Set 23” (21 July 2024) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the errata card image (24 July 2024, 3 days after release)<ref name="ht-68ad3ba">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/68ad3bacad81fda51e9730e4dd5e1c0e7b04be54/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/lifeday.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Light/large/lifeday.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/68ad3bacad81fda51e9730e4dd5e1c0e7b04be54 68ad3ba] “Life Day proofing fix”, 24 July 2024, 3 days after release.</ref> prints: “When drawn for destiny, if three Ewoks and/or Wookiees on table, destiny +2. Deploy a bowcaster or Ewok weapon from Lost Pile. OR Take an Ewok or Wookiee of power < 6 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During battle at same site as Part Of The Tribe, add one battle destiny.” '''What changed:''' In the destiny line, “three Wookiees and/or Ewoks” became “three Ewoks and/or Wookiees” (the two words swapped). No errata mark was printed. The PC card data still gives the original order. The card image prints no errata mark.
'''What changed, as printed''' (crops cut unchanged from the two published card images: before = [[Life Day]], after = this page):

</gallery>
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Life Day (Errata 2)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 6, file created 2 August 2024: “When drawn for destiny, if three Ewoks and/or Wookiees on table, destiny +2. Deploy a bowcaster or Ewok weapon from Lost Pile. OR Take an Ewok or Wookiee of power < 6 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During battle at same site as Part Of The Tribe, add one battle destiny.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Life Day (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Life Day (Errata)]] (published 24 July 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•Life Day”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
